description: Start a Vybe Collect payment under the owner's connected spend key (OAuth Sign in or Bearer VAPT). Creates a pending pay and returns awaiting_approval — money does not move until the wallet owner taps Approve in Vybe (web or mobile). After paid (or trial), call use_paid_offering with the returned publicId — that unlocks research files, lists/runs seller MCP tools, or proxies paid API calls. Do not scrape the marketplace page. Pass username plus offeringId, or a Collect / marketplace offeringUrl. Related: use_paid_offering, fetch_paid_content, get_limits, get_spend_balance, list_recent_pays.

inputSchema.description: Identify the Collect offering to pay. Provide username and offeringId together, or offeringUrl alone.

calls.description: Optional. Buy a prepaid bundle of this many calls (see bundles in get_tool), usually cheaper per call. Omit it to use free calls and bundle calls first; when those run out, a tool that sells bundles charges for its smallest bundle, and only tools without bundles charge for one call.

offeringId.description: Collect offering id from the seller catalog, for example svc_gMcO7ioZ. Required with username when offeringUrl is omitted.

offeringUrl.description: Full Collect or marketplace URL for the offering, including tool pages like https://www.vybe.finance/marketplace/tools/{slug} (offeringUrl from search_tools). Use this instead of username plus offeringId when you already have the link.

username.description: Seller Collect username without the @ prefix, for example yellobots. Required with offeringId when offeringUrl is omitted.

inputSchema.title: PayOfferingInput

name: pay_offering

outputSchema.description: Result of starting a Collect pay. Money does not move until the owner Approves in Vybe.

amount.description: USD amount as a decimal string, e.g. 0.02.

approveUrl.description: Link for the owner to Approve or Decline in Vybe.

invokeUrl.description: After paid or trial: GET this URL with header X-Vybe-Public-Id set to publicId to receive the unlocked content.

message.description: Short instruction for the agent to show the user.

nextAction.description: Machine-readable next step after Approve: which tool to call and with which publicId.

offeringType.description: Collect offering type: mcp, api, asset, session, etc.

ok.description: true when the pay was created or a trial was granted.

status.description: awaiting_approval means the owner must Approve in Vybe. trusted_awaiting means a connected merchant pay is queued quietly. trial means a free call was granted and prepaid means one call was spent from a bought bundle; neither needs Approve.

statusUrl.description: Poll this URL for paid / pending / cancelled.

unlock.description: Exact unlock step: call use_paid_offering with publicId. Do not scrape marketplace HTML or invent seller HTTP calls.

outputSchema.title: PayOfferingResult

title: Pay Collect offering
